mapper.sql: cisd.id, cisd.create_user_id, cisd.create_user_name, cisd.create_time, cisd.update_user_id, cisd.update_user_name, cisd.update_time, cisd.version, cisd.is_deleted, cisd.main_id, cisd.dict_platform, cisd.shop_id, cisd.dict_invoice_rule, cisd.ratio, cisd.is_contain_ship_fee, cisd.tax_type, cisd.invoice_node, cisd.is_auto_upload
mapper.select: SELECT cisd.main_id AS mainId, si.name, si.dict_platform FROM cfg_invoice_setting_detail cisd LEFT JOIN shop_info si ON cisd.shop_id = si.id WHERE cisd.is_deleted = FALSE;

SELECT cisd.id AS id, cisd.shop_id AS shopId, cisd.main_id AS mainId, cisd.dict_invoice_rule AS dictInvoiceRule, cisd.ratio AS ratio, cisd.is_contain_ship_fee AS isContainShipFee, cisd.tax_type AS taxType, cisd.invoice_node AS invoiceNode, cisd.is_auto_upload AS isAutoUpload, cisd.dict_platform AS dictPlatform FROM cfg_invoice_setting_detail cisd LEFT JOIN shop_info si ON cisd.shop_id = si.id WHERE cisd.is_deleted = FALSE And cisd.main_id = #{mainId} ;
